Do I have to use YAM for the shipping afterwards?
No. The advice stands on its own. Many clients do ask us to run the shipments, since we already know the plan inside out.
What do you need from me?
Product details or HS codes, typical volumes, supplier and buyer locations, current costs if you have them, and any deadlines.
A focused question, such as which port or which Incoterm, usually takes a few days. A full supply chain review takes longer, and we agree the scope upfront.
Is this legal or tax advice?
No. We advise on customs, freight and trade procedure. For legal or tax opinions we will tell you when to bring in a lawyer or chartered accountant.
